newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks trading limit may be widened-analysts.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks trading limit may be widened-analysts.

text.p: Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) officials were set to review daily trading limits on share prices on Friday, and analysts said the review may see present trading bands widened significantly.

Stocks are currently allowed to trade within a 10 percent ceiling or floor based on the previous day's close. This has helped to restrain the market's rally after the baht's managed float on Wednesday.

"They're expected to raise it (trading limits) to 33 percent," said one analyst. "That will make it (the market) much more volatile." But others said the officials, who were due to begin meeting at 0500 GMT, may decide to hold off on any changes now.
Any decision to alter the limits would only take place next week, an SET official said.
During the share market's rally over the past three days, most major stocks have stuck at their 10 percent upper daily limit within the first few hours of trade, and orders could not be completed.
